action_items: (minor/cosmetic) Normalise the origin substring inside /api/demo/reference (and/or SihDemo.jsx demo-reference-label) from 'LIVE DETECTED' to 'VARUNA DETECTED' so /demo matches the taxonomy shown in the Investigation cases table for the same case.
critical_code_review_comments: Positive: /api/ais/status carefully exposes key_configured (bool) but never the AISSTREAM_API_KEY value, and the STANDBY reason string clearly explains AIS_INGEST_ENABLED=false — a good production-safety pattern.
Positive: analyze-eligible is idempotent by design — 2nd invocation returned an identical (empty) queued list and the ref case's correlation_result version remained 1, i.e. no re-run.
Positive: evidence-timeline endpoint models truthfully — 'unavailable' entries with 'Not available' state for corridor/closest on NOT_ANALYZED cases, avoiding fabricated timestamps.
Positive: jurisdictions/lookup returns both 'primary' and 'zones' array with code=CAN-EEZ, provenance=REFERENCE and source citing Marine Regions v12; keeps evidentiary chain clean.

Nit: /api/demo/reference response embeds a case-level origin label that still says 'LIVE DETECTED' whereas the case list now says 'VARUNA DETECTED'. Consider centralising the ORIGIN_LABEL mapping so all read paths agree.
